# Duncan Leung – JavaScript Engineer

> > Personal site of Duncan Leung, Lead Frontend Engineer writing in-depth tutorials on React, TypeScript, Go, and modern web development.

Duncan Leung is a Lead Frontend Engineer at Airvet specializing in React, TypeScript, and Go. This site features technical articles, learning resources, and professional portfolio content focused on frontend development, serverless architecture, and developer tooling.

## Go Programming

- [Understanding Interfaces in Go](https://duncanleung.com/understand-go-golang-interfaces): Go interfaces tutorial: duck typing, polymorphism, and receiver functions
- [Go Idioms: Accept Interfaces, Return Types](https://duncanleung.com/go-idiom-accept-interfaces-return-types): Go best practices: accepting interfaces and returning concrete types
- [Basic Data Structures in Go](https://duncanleung.com/go-basic-data-structures-types-pointers-structs-arrays-slices-int-float-string): Go fundamentals: integers, floats, strings, arrays, pointers, and memory
- [Indexing Strings and Runes in Go](https://duncanleung.com/iterating-index-strings-runes-go-golang): Go string indexing, runes, UTF-8 encoding, and byte representation
- [Go Function Argument Passing Behavior](https://duncanleung.com/go-function-arguments-passed-by-value): How Go passes function arguments by value with pointers and slices
